faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment is 01 September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Associate-I position at NIT Silchar, candidates must possess an MSc. in Chemistry or a BS-MS in Chemistry. Ensure your qualifications meet these requirements before applying.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I post is 30 years. However, age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per the Government of India rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I recruitment at NIT Silchar will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience, and then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA. The exact salary will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Project Associate-I recruitment at NIT Silchar. This applies to all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job opening?
faq.answer: The application for the NIT Silchar Project Associate-I recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with necessary documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position at the National Institute of Technology Silchar. This is a single opening, so interested candidates should ensure they meet all the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position at NIT Silchar is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure, as specified in the appointment letter and as per the project requirements.
